column2: Guan Yu stands turned to the right in near profile, chin raised, his left hand slowly stroking his very long flowing beard, his right hand planting the Green Dragon crescent blade (guandao) upright beside him. Expression: calm, proud, narrowed phoenix eyes gazing into the distance.

Zhang Fei alone at Changban Bridge, feet planted, thrusting his long serpent spear diagonally across his body, head thrown back as he roars at an unseen army; beard bristling. A few pale strokes hint at a wooden bridge rail behind him. Expression: thunderous roar, mouth wide open, round glaring eyes.

Liu Bei at the Peach Garden oath, turned three-quarter to the left, lifting a small wine cup high with both hands toward the sky, long sleeves falling back; one branch of peach blossom in pale gray ink reaches in from the top corner. Expression: gentle but resolute, eyes lifted, a faint warm smile.

Cao Cao on the prow of his warship the night before Red Cliffs, composing a poem: a long lance held level in his right hand, a wine cup raised in his left, cloak streaming in the river wind, head turned toward a thin crescent moon; two pale wave lines below. Expression: confident half-smile, sharp sidelong eyes.

Lu Bu seen from a low angle, back half turned to us, glaring down over his shoulder; the two long pheasant tail feathers of his headdress whip in a great arc, his sky-piercing halberd rests across his shoulders. Expression: arrogant sneer, fierce eyes looking down on the viewer.

Zhuge Liang calling the east wind: he stands turned three-quarter to the right, robe and sleeves blown hard by the wind, crane-feather fan lifted lightly before his chest, the other hand behind his back, face tilted up to the sky. A few pale sweeping strokes show the wind. Expression: serene, eyes half closed, a faint knowing smile.

Zhao Yun at Changban, twisting in the saddle to look back at his pursuers: his left arm shelters a swaddled infant against his breastplate, his right hand levels a long spear behind him; only a few brush strokes of the horse's flying mane show at the bottom edge. Expression: alert, determined, protective.

Diaochan praying to the moon in a night garden: seen from behind at three-quarter, she turns her head back over her shoulder, hands joined holding a single incense stick, long sleeves and sash drifting; a thin crescent moon in pale wash at the top corner. Expression: wistful, eyes lowered, a trace of sorrow.

young Sun Ce, the Little Conqueror, striding forward and laughing, one fist on his hip, a spear slung across his shoulders with the other hand, short cape flying behind him, head turned to call to someone at his side. Expression: bold, fearless, a wide bright grin.

Xiahou Dun in the thick of battle, one eye bound with a cloth patch, his raised left fist clenching a broken arrow shaft beside his face, his right hand swinging a heavy saber back for the next blow, body lunging to the left. No blood. Expression: ferocious defiance, teeth bared in a shout.

the white-bearded veteran Huang Zhong draws a great war bow to full stretch, aiming up to the right, the arrow at his cheek, his long white beard blown sideways. Expression: fierce concentration, one eye narrowed along the arrow.

Zhou Yu commanding the fire attack at Red Cliffs: he stands in the wind turned three-quarter to the left, one arm thrust out pointing ahead, the other hand on the hilt of the sword at his waist, cloak whipping behind; far behind him a few pale gray strokes of rising flame and smoke. Expression: elegant, assured, a slight smile.
